title: IRS Statistics of Income: individual income tax data by ZIP code, county, state and migration (irs.gov)
agency: Internal Revenue Service, Statistics of Income Division
questions: average adjusted gross income by ZIP code in Maryland
number of tax returns and total AGI by county
share of returns with income over $200,000 by state
earned income tax credit claims by county
how many taxpayers moved from New York to Florida and how much income they took
net migration of tax filers into Texas counties
state and local tax deduction by ZIP code

manual.how: Open the product's index page on irs.gov (ZIP code data: https://www.irs.gov/statistics/soi-tax-stats-individual-income-tax-statistics-zip-code-data-soi; county data: https://www.irs.gov/statistics/soi-tax-stats-county-data; state data: https://www.irs.gov/statistics/soi-tax-stats-historic-table-2; migration data: https://www.irs.gov/statistics/soi-tax-stats-migration-data), open the tax year (or filing-year pair) and download the all-states CSV named in INSTRUCTIONS.md (for example 22incyallagi.csv), then upload it unchanged; --ingest filters it by the spec. The per-state Excel files are not read by --ingest.

cache.why: Each request downloads one published all-states CSV (0.1 MB for state migration up to 216 MB for ZIP code data) and keeps only the asked rows; data/ is reused within a run only.

redistribution.why: SOI tax statistics are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105) and are published already aggregated with disclosure protection; cite IRS SOI and the retrieval date.

citation: Internal Revenue Service, Statistics of Income Division, {dataset}, irs.gov/statistics, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which tax year (ZIP, county and state data) or which pair of filing years (migration: 2022-2023 compares addresses on returns filed in 2022 and 2023)? Default: the latest posted (tax year 2023; migration 2022-2023).
All returns combined, or broken out by AGI size class (agi_stub)? Averages such as AGI per return need the all-classes total (ZIP 00000 / county 000 rows or the no-AGI-class file).
Migration: people moving into the place (inflow) or out of it (outflow), between states or between counties? Net migration needs both.
